input.command: ls -la dotenv tests; echo "---"; find . -maxdepth 3 -type f -not -path './.git/*' | head -100
cat README* 2>/dev/null | head -50; echo "---GIT---"; git -C . log --oneline -5 2>/dev/null; git status --short 2>/dev/null | head
sed -n '1,40p' dotenv/variables.py; echo "=== main set_key ==="; sed -n '131,200p' dotenv/main.py

cd /workspace && python -c "
import io
from dotenv.parser import parse_stream, decode_escapes, _double_quote_escapes, _single_quote_escapes
for s in ['X=\"line\\\\nnext\"\n', \"X='a\\\\'b'\n\", 'X=plain\n']:
    rows=list(parse_stream(io.StringIO(s)))
    print(repr(s), '->', [ (r.key, r.value, r.error) for r in rows])
print('decode double:', repr(decode_escapes(_double_quote_escapes, r'line\nnext')))
print('decode single:', repr(decode_escapes(_single_quote_escapes, r'a\'b')))
"
cd /workspace && python -m unittest discover -s tests -v 2>&1 | tail -50

cd /workspace && grep -rn "decode_escapes\|_quote_escapes\|_quoted_value\|parse_value\|parse_unquoted_value" --include=*.py . ; echo "=== git? ==="; ls -a .yecoding; sqlite3 .yecoding/code_index.sqlite3 "select name from sqlite_master where type='table';" 2>/dev/null
cd /workspace && ls -laR --ignore=code_index.sqlite3 . && echo "=== hashes ===" && find . -name '*.py' -exec md5sum {} \;
cd /workspace && sed -n '1,30p' dotenv/parser.py | cat -n && echo "..." && sed -n '95,135p' dotenv/parser.py | nl -ba -v95
